I'm really sorry to hear that. When life is heavy for a few weeks, trying to keep up with a demanding training plan on top of it can just feel like another chore. 

Getting through the door is the hardest part, but if the current volume is constantly draining you, we should adjust the plan so it actually supports you instead of wearing you down. 

We can drop the volume on your training days to make the sessions lighter and easier to recover from for the rest of this block. Or, if you need a breather, we can take a look at your weekly schedule. What feels like it would give you the most breathing room right now?
